text.p: The following are reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Church leaders of ten countries signed the Porvoo declaration in Tallinn on Sunday.
- President Lennart Meri rejected allegations that he collaborated with with the KGB in a television broadcast on Sunday.
- The Tallinn City council and St Petersburg legislative assembly signed cooperation agreements.
- Presidential candidate Arnold Ruutel denied he cooperated with repressive Soviet agencies.
- A joint working group of Estonian and Finnish defence forces has been formed to coordinate defence cooperation and to assist Estonia in the building of its defense system.
- Two bids by an Estonian business group and a local Russian businessman have been made for the privatisation of the Sillamae metal processing plant RAS Silmet
